welcomeMessage: Oii [TEPI], Happy Birthday! 14 years of being the most annoying, most lovable disaster in my life. I still remember stealing your toys just to watch you cry and then giving them right back because your face is impossible to say no to. You've somehow gone from tiny chaos gremlin to a whole teenager now, and honestly? Still chaos, just taller. This entire website is my gift to you — every embarrassing baby photo, every memory, every bit of us. I love you so much, [TIKTIKI]. Now scroll before I change my mind and delete this whole thing.

lovedOneMessages.name: Mom
lovedOneMessages.message: My sweet [BARBI], watching you grow up has been the greatest joy of my life. Happy Birthday, my darling!

lovedOneMessages.name: Dad
lovedOneMessages.message: Happy Birthday, [BARBI]! Stay as bright and fearless as you are today. We're so proud of you.

finaleMessage: Okay [TIKTIKI], real talk for one second — no matter how much I tease you, you're genuinely one of my favorite humans on this planet. 14 is going to be a good year on you, I can already tell. Stay weird, stay loud, stay exactly you. Happy Birthday, my favorite pain in the neck. Now go blow out that candle already. 🎂💗

quizzes.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
If you drop a yellow hat in the Red Sea, what does it become?
What has keys but can't open locks?
You see a boat filled with people, yet there isn't a single person on board. How?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
